svg.text: Candidate 01 — one request, five guarantees
Spec 37 steps 1.1–1.6 · api.ts said it itself: “the app has ~8 near-identical private request helpers… the test passed and proved nothing.”
BEFORE — every call site picked its own idiom
~8 private request helpers across the client,
each with a different set of guarantees:
• some had timeouts, some would hang forever
• some sent the profile header, some didn't
• some threw sentences, some threw status codes
• safety came from a global fetch monkey-patch
installed in main.tsx, before any request ran
ProfileSwitcher: no timeout, no try/catch — unhandled rejection on any failure.
AFTER — client/src/lib/request.ts
request<T>(path, options)
requestRaw — streaming, 304s
The five guarantees, each pinned by a test:
1 · Bounded — a dead host rejects, never hangs
2 · Authenticated — cookie (web) or session header (Android)
3 · Profile-scoped — x-profile-id on every call
4 · One error vocabulary — copy.ts sentences, never server prose
5 · Offline-aware — explicit offline mode refuses, doesn't hang
The admin panel got its own sibling (admin/request.ts) with its own credential; the deadline rule moved to lib/bounded.ts, shared by both bundles.
Step 1.2 found a live bug on the way: three call sites sent JSON-inside-JSON (double-encoded bodies) — caught by the typecheck gate from step 0.1, made unrepresentable by the type.
